description: Get statistical values for a variable_id from gus-poland.variables, broken down by territorial unit. Use unit_level (0=Poland, 1=macroregion, 2=voivodeship, 3=region, 4=subregion, 5=powiat, 6=gmina, 7=locality; default 2) to get all units at that level, or a specific unit_id (12-digit TERYT code, e.g. "000000000000" for all of Poland) for one unit's full series. Optionally filter by year(s). Data: bdl.stat.gov.pl (GUS BDL API v1), no auth required.

unit_id.description: BDL 12-digit territorial unit code to fetch a single unit's series (e.g. "000000000000" for all of Poland, "011200000000" for Małopolskie voivodeship). If set, unit_level is ignored.

unit_level.description: Administrative level to break the data down by when unit_id is not set: 0=Poland, 1=macroregion, 2=voivodeship, 3=region, 4=subregion, 5=powiat (county), 6=gmina (municipality), 7=statistical locality. Default 2 (voivodeship).

variable_id.description: Numeric variable id from gus-poland.variables (e.g. 4859 for "wheat 1 dt" procurement price).

year.description: One or more specific years to filter by, e.g. [2022, 2023]. Omit to return the full available history.

name: gus-poland.series.data

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get GUS Poland BDL Statistical Data
